question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a blue ball, Bob has a grey ball, Claire has a purple ball, Dave has a gold ball, Eve has a pink ball, Fred has a black ball, and Gertrude has a yellow ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Fred and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Claire and Dave swap balls. Then, Fred and Dave swap balls. Then, Alice and Eve swap balls. Then, Dave and Alice swap balls. Then, Eve and Dave swap balls. Finally, Alice and Gertrude swap balls. At the end of the game, Claire has the
Options:
(A) blue ball
(B) grey ball
(C) purple ball
(D) gold ball
(E) pink ball
(F) black ball
(G) yellow ball
solution:
Ball colors in every row are listed for (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude).
Initial: (blue, grey, purple, gold, pink, black, yellow)
1. Fred and Gertrude swap: (blue, grey, purple, gold, pink, yellow, black)
2. Claire and Dave swap: (blue, grey, gold, purple, pink, yellow, black)
3. Fred and Dave swap: (blue, grey, gold, yellow, pink, purple, black)
4. Alice and Eve swap: (pink, grey, gold, yellow, blue, purple, black)
5. Dave and Alice swap: (yellow, grey, gold, pink, blue, purple, black)
6. Eve and Dave swap: (yellow, grey, gold, blue, pink, purple, black)
7. Alice and Gertrude swap: (black, grey, gold, blue, pink, purple, yellow)
Claire has the gold ball, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
